title: Remove Word Comments – Clear Tracked Changes in a DOCX
description: Remove every comment from a Word document and accept or reject all tracked changes in your browser, for a clean .docx to send. Free, no upload.
heading: Remove comments from Word
subtitle: Delete all comments and accept or reject every tracked change in a Word document, for a clean copy to send; nothing is uploaded.
intro: Clean a DOCX file before you send it: every comment and its replies is removed, and tracked changes are either all accepted or all rejected, so the reader sees only the final text. It is useful before sending a contract, a CV or a report outside your team. The rest of the document stays as it was. The file is cleaned in your browser and never uploaded.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your document is cleaned by your own browser and never sent to a server, so nobody else sees it.

features.title: Comments and replies
features.text: Every comment is removed together with its replies.

features.title: Tracked changes settled
features.text: Accept all or reject all tracked changes, so no markup is left in the file.

stepsTitle: How to remove comments from a Word document

steps.title: Choose your document
steps.text: Click Choose a file, or drop a .docx file on the page.

steps.title: Choose accept or reject
steps.text: Choose whether to accept all or reject all tracked changes.

steps.title: Clean and download
steps.text: Click Remove and download the clean Word document.

handles: Comments: every comment and its replies.
Tracked changes: all accepted or all rejected.
Result: a clean .docx; the rest of the document is unchanged.
limits: It is all or nothing: you can't keep some comments and remove others.
Tracked changes are all accepted or all rejected, not one by one.
Old .doc files can't be read; save them as .docx first.
mayNotKeep: Changes you would accept one by one

faq.question: Is my file uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your file is read and changed by your own browser, on your device, and is never sent anywhere. You can check it: open your browser's network panel while you use the tool and you will see no upload.

faq.question: How do I remove all comments from a Word document?
faq.answer: Removing all comments deletes every note and reply from the margin in one step; Word and LibreOffice both have a delete-all-comments command. On this page, choose the .docx, pick accept all or reject all for tracked changes and download a clean copy, cleaned in your browser.

faq.question: What happens to tracked changes?
faq.answer: You choose: accept all keeps the suggested text, reject all goes back to the original. Either way no markup is left.

faq.question: Are replies removed too?
faq.answer: Yes. Each comment is removed with all its replies.

faq.question: Can I keep some comments?
faq.answer: No. The tool removes every comment; to keep a few, delete the others one by one in Word.

faq.question: Does it remove the author's name from the file?
faq.answer: It removes the names shown on comments and tracked changes. The author stored in the file's properties is removed by Word metadata.
